title: W660
description_html:
Advanced Technology and Operator Convenience:

Our new seeder features a hydraulic lifting drawbar, designed to provide simpler and more efficient operation, eliminating the need for manual intervention by the operator. In addition, its lower hydraulic consumption ensures optimal performance at all times.

Versatility in Size:

The available size range, from 20 rows at 52.5 cm to 32 rows at 52.5 cm, with options for additional configurations, allows farmers to adapt the machine to their specific needs.

Modular Design with Connecting Hinges:

This design allows a single rotational movement between odd-numbered modules, streamlining operations and facilitating adaptation to different conditions.

Hinges with Sliding Pin System:

This system provides greater control over the rotation of the seeding units. Rotation limits ensure precise seeding in rows spaced 35 to 38 cm apart, which is essential for coarse grain production.

title: W650 IMPERIAL
description_html:
Forward Transport Folding:

3.10 m tire footprint | 4 m total width when folded, with ample ground clearance.
specs: Hydraulic Variable Seeding and Fertilization Rate Control
Optional cutting by furrow or section
Seeding Monitor and Variable Rate Control Series
Simple fertilization in the row or off the row
image_alt: W650 IMPERIAL

title: W650 AUTOTRAILER
description_html:
Frame:

It features a solid and robust frame designed to withstand the most demanding conditions, both during operation and transport. The row-unit mounting system is faster and easier to adjust to all row spacings from 350 mm onwards. The components are designed to achieve precision seeding and a long service life while maintaining optimal operating conditions.

Hoppers: High-capacity plastic hoppers with dual compartments for in-row and between-row fertilization. Foldable divider to combine the capacity or split it into two compartments. Chevron-type metering units with emptying cover for easy cleaning. Between-row fertilizer application through an angled cutting blade with a gauge wheel for precise placement at the desired location and depth.
image_alt: W650 AUTOTRAILER

title: W650
description_html: This model features larger-capacity hoppers, allowing fertilization both in-row and alongside the seed row.
specs: Fertilizes in rows with direct drop to the row unit

title: W630 3-Point Hitch
description_html:
Fertilization:

High-capacity plastic hoppers with 126 liters per row. The metering units are chevron-type and feature an emptying cover for easy cleaning. It can fertilize both in-row and between-row simultaneously, using two 36-speed gearboxes for accurate metering.

Seeding Metering Unit:

Seeding density is achieved through 32-speed oil-bath gearboxes protected by a safety release mechanism. They allow the exact quantity of seed to be sown to be metered by simply positioning the lever according to the seeding chart.

Hydraulic System:

The Super Walter W630 seeder is equipped with a hydraulic circuit operated by a single tractor control to activate the two marker cylinders, with their corresponding sequential valve.

Seeding and Fertilization System:

For in-row fertilizer placement, the first toolbar features a cutting blade for no-till seeding. It is equipped with 16" corrugated blades (turbo optional), with either shear-bolt or spring release, which open the furrow. Fertilizer is delivered independently of the seed, placing it precisely in front of and below the seed.
image_alt: W630 3-Point Hitch

title: W630
description_html:
Single and Double Fertilization:

Precise metering is achieved through mechanical variable-rate gearboxes or a hydraulic motor. Seed distribution is carried out through a mechanical or pneumatic metering system with 54-speed gearboxes.

Mechanical Metering:

Our system provides gentle and smooth seed handling, reducing the possibility of seed damage. Maintenance-free. No greasing required.

title: W4500
description_html:
Longitudinal Transport:

This model offers the option of incorporating a front hitch transport kit, allowing the operator to couple and uncouple the seeder for different applications.

Excellent Ground Following:

Its ability to follow the terrain with more than 30 cm of ground contouring makes a difference when seeding rice and fine grains. In addition, this machine is equipped with special row units specifically designed for these crops.
specs: All sizes from 17 x 17.5 to 62 x 17.5
Special row units for rice and fine grain seeding

title: W1770 TRIFLEX
description_html:
Hydraulic Innovation:

Effortless Operation: The W1770 TRIFLEX is equipped with a hydraulic lifting drawbar, designed to make the operator's work easier. This feature eliminates the need for manual intervention, making each seeding day faster and more efficient, while its low hydraulic consumption ensures optimal performance on any terrain.

More Capacity, More Performance With an improved chassis that supports a greater number of hoppers, the W1770 TRIFLEX increases its seeding capacity, allowing you to cover more hectares in less time. It is the perfect tool for maximizing seeding time across large agricultural areas.

Versatility and Precision on All Types of Soil The W1770 TRIFLEX's advanced technology ensures superior ground following, guaranteeing uniform depth in every furrow and precise seed distribution. Unmatched Productivity in Fine Grains The W1770 TRIFLEX seeder not only optimizes the seeding process, but also provides unmatched versatility, adapting to different soil types and conditions. With this seeder, every pass is synonymous with efficiency, precision, and performance.
image_alt: W1770 TRIFLEX

title: W1770 SERIES IV
description_html:
Frame:

Solid and robust. Designed to withstand the most demanding conditions, both during operation and transport.

Alfalfa Hopper:

Direct drop into the seeding unit. Forced-feed system. 36-speed gearbox.

Fertilizer Hopper:

In-row fertilization with direct drop into the seeding unit. Chevron-type metering units with individual emptying and cleaning covers. Prevents fertilizer from being spread over the machine, avoiding the resulting inconveniences and damage.

Dual-Purpose Seed Hopper:

Double fluted-feed rollers or chevron-type feeders.
image_alt: W1770 SERIES IV

title: W1770 AIR DRILL Series V
description_html:
Supply Cart:

Consists of two individual hoppers, with a total capacity of 12,000 liters. 40/60% seed + fertilizer option. If necessary, an additional 1,200-liter hopper can be added, allocating capacity from the main hopper for increased fertilizer application.

Ladders:

Internal and external ladders provide easy and safe access.

Fertilization:

The XL – optional XXL – offers 3 possibilities: • In-row fertilization • Side-band fertilization • Double fertilization

Hopper Cart Tires:

2 high-flotation 23.1 x 26 tires. Fenders and safety lighting for operation and transport.
